what: Error by distance from the nearest tile boundary, grid seam repair OFF against ON with the same exit map. This is the table the paper quotes and the figure draws.
provenance: Transcribed from DECISIONS.md section 82. Measured with the protocol now held in scripts/seam_spatial.py, on runs/BEST/ckpt_eval.pth.tar, whose epoch was not recorded at the time and which the per-epoch watcher has since overwritten, so the ON column cannot be reproduced from anything now on disk. The OFF column reproduces to four decimals on the pinned runs/BEST/ckpt_epo0.pth.tar (see results/seam_spatial.json), which is what establishes that the protocol is the same one.
